## Checklist

- [ ] Both loader builds and applicable regression/client tests pass (name exact loader/Minecraft versions and separate build, data checks and actual in-game tests)
- [ ] Archive compatibility, persistence and file validity/completeness remain covered where affected
- [ ] New or changed texts exist in `en_us.json` **and** `de_de.json`
- [ ] Interface changes follow the checklist in [ACCESSIBILITY.md](../ACCESSIBILITY.md) (keyboard, contrast, no color-only information, reduced motion)
- [ ] User-facing changes are documented (README / HOW_TO_USE)
- [ ] The change stays within the project boundaries in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
